title: Midnight Security Vigil
description: A security guard sits at a wooden desk in a dimly lit room, reviewing an open book under a green lamp while rain falls through a broken skylight. Behind him, a large surreal painting depicts a decaying yellow hallway with an open door, red 'EXIT' sign, and peeling walls.
prompt: A lone security guard in uniform sits at a desk with a green lamp, open book, coffee mug, keys and walkie-talkie, looking down at his work as rain pours through a broken skylight in a purple-toned room. A massive surreal painting on the wall shows a decaying yellow hallway with open door, glowing red EXIT sign above, and peeling paint. Cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
